notes: «أبيه» is named only by relation; the encounter «دخلنا على جابر بن عبد الله» places the speaker with Jabir.
Jabir is the last link: he speaks and relays the Prophet's hajj («قال جابر لسنا ننوي إلا الحج»). Owner ruling 5.
The narrator's own «أنا محمد بن علي بن الحسين» is not a transmitter and is not written; the Prophet is the end of the chain.
